deal_name: Zephyr Logistics India - Revenue & Tariff Leakage Analytics

items.fact: Karan Singhania is the VP of Operations and the primary internal project champion.
Harish Iyer is the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and primary financial decision-maker.
CFO Harish Iyer is skeptical of SaaS ROI due to 4.2% thin freight margins and past failed BI dashboard rollouts.
Billing reconciliations across 14 warehouse hubs currently take 18 days each month-end across SAP and Tally systems.
Ananya Sen is the Lead Data Architect responsible for Snowflake integration and API performance validation.
AE promised to send benchmark load test reports and SOC 2 Type II audit documentation by Friday afternoon.
Data infra team flagged concern regarding API rate limits under 1.8M month-end transactional spike volumes.
Competitor Datawise offered their complete analytics suite at INR 22 Lakhs with waived onboarding services.
CFO Harish Iyer rejected the INR 45 Lakhs ARR proposal and capped software budget at INR 25 Lakhs all-inclusive.
Deepak Verma is the CFO of BlueDart Freight Network who served as reference customer.
BlueDart reference call demonstrated INR 1.14 Crores unbilled freight recovery and a 92-day payback period.
CFO Harish Iyer reversed his skeptical stance after the reference call and agreed to restructure commercials around milestone payments.
Rajesh Kulkarni is the new VP of Enterprise Architecture questioning whether to build custom Apache Flink stream processing in-house.
Champion Karan Singhania shifted from highly enthusiastic to hesitant and nervous regarding warehouse user adoption and shift handover friction.
CFO Harish Iyer raised a NEW concern regarding implementation vulnerability and pipeline latency stalling 2 AM dispatch batch runs.
Rajesh Kulkarni mandated a sub-100ms webhook SLA and local edge caching for AWS VPC network partitions.
Deal restructured into a milestone-contingent payment structure with 30 consecutive error-free days for Phase 2 INR 20 Lakhs tranche.
AE promised to have legal draft the SLA addendum with specific 30-day milestone acceptance criteria by Wednesday.
